mapper.select: select tp.id AS tp_id, tp.created_at, tp.modified_at, tp.deleted_at, tp.title as tp_title, tp.description, tp.start_date, tp.end_date, tp.member_id, tp.like_count, tp.view_count, m.id AS m_id, m.email, m.name, m.role, m.birth_date, m.profile_image, tpd.id AS tpd_id, tpd.date, tpd.day_order, tpd.trip_plan_id, pi.id AS pi_id, pi.description as pi_description, pi.item_order, pi.item_type, pi.trip_plan_day_id, pi.attraction_id, pi.member_place_id, a.id AS a_id, a.content_id, a.title, a.image1, a.image2, a.map_level, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.tel, a.address1, a.address2, a.homepage, mp.id AS mp_id, mp.created_at, mp.modified_at, mp.name as mp_name, mp.latitude as mp_latitude, mp.longitude as mp_longitude, mp.description as mp_description, mp.address as mp_address, mp.image as mp_image, mp.like_count, mp.deleted_at as mp_deleted_at, r.id AS r_id, r.from_item_id, r.to_item_id, r.distance, r.duration, ac.category_id as a_category_id, ac.category_name as a_category_name, mc.category_id as m_category_id, mc.category_name as m_category_name, ts.style as ts_style from trip_plan tp join member m on tp.member_id = m.id left join trip_plan_day tpd on tp.id = tpd.trip_plan_id left join plan_item pi on tpd.id = pi.trip_plan_day_id left join attraction a on pi.attraction_id IS NOT NULL AND pi.attraction_id = a.id left join category ac on pi.attraction_id IS NOT NULL AND a.category_id = ac.category_id left join member_place mp on pi.member_place_id IS NOT NULL AND pi.member_place_id = mp.id left join category mc on pi.member_place_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.category_id = mc.category_id LEFT JOIN trip_style ts ON tp.id = ts.trip_plan_id left join route_connection r on r.from_item_id = ( select p2.id from plan_item p2 WHERE p2.trip_plan_day_id = pi.trip_plan_day_id AND p2.item_order = pi.item_order - 1 LIMIT 1 ) where tp.id = #{id} and tp.deleted_at IS NULL;

tp.deleted_at IS NULL

)
AND tp.season IN
#{season}

LEFT JOIN trip_plan_like tpl ON tpl.trip_plan_id = tp.id AND tpl.member_id = #{loginMemberId} AND tpl.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN trip_plan_like tpl ON 1=0

SELECT count(DISTINCT tp.id) FROM trip_plan tp JOIN member m ON tp.member_id = m.id JOIN trip_plan_day tpd ON tp.id = tpd.trip_plan_id
tp.deleted_at IS NULL AND tp.member_id = #{memberId}
AND #{now} < tp.start_date
AND #{now} BETWEEN tp.start_date AND tp.end_date
